Batch.description: Each batch has a batch_id, which increments.

btc_requested.description: If the batch is in WITHDRAWING or FINALIZED, how much BTC was requested?

collected_amount.description: If in FINALIZED state, how much BTC was actually collected?

collector_historical_balance.description: Historical collector balance recorded at the time the batch transitions to WITHDRAWING

maxbtc_burned.description: The amount of maxBTC burned for this batch

paid_amount.description: If in FINALIZED state, how much BTC was already paid to users?
